parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame of the refrigerator, made of steel, providing structural support and housing for internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the doors, insulation, and internal compartments, maintaining the refrigerator’s rigidity and shape.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Upper Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the upper door of the refrigerator, typically made of stainless steel, covering the main cooling compartment.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the main refrigeration section and helps maintain internal temperature by sealing tightly when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Lower Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the lower door of the refrigerator, made of stainless steel, typically covering the freezer compartment.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the freezer section and ensures proper insulation when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a horizontal or vertical hinge axis depending on design, allowing access to the freezer compartment.
